mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.
objective: Capture local and remote branch heads and trees.

acceptedEvidence.claim: The required worktree-snapshot dependency passed at matrix revision 7.

allowedReads: Git refs, commit parent IDs, tree IDs, tracking configuration, worktree metadata, and public remote heads
Prior source-authority snapshot and matrix-control artifacts
exclusions: No checkout, switch, fetch, pull, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, stash, reset, clean, push, or branch mutation
No source-content edits or blob reads
No credentials, deployment, publication, or external submission
acceptanceGate: Default branch, tracking state, commit graph, and tree equality are recorded.
oneFixPlan: Record default branch, local and remote tracking state, commit topology, divergence, and tree equality.
validationCommand: Repeat ref, tree, and ls-remote observations and reject any mismatch.
cancellationRule: Stop before any Git mutation, on remote/auth failure, or when matrix state is stale.
